subject: Renewal + Expansion: pricing follow-up & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: Joe Miller <joe.miller@acme-edge.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.inference>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + Expansion: pricing follow-up & next steps

Thanks for the time this morning, Joe
 great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we don't lose momentum:

What we discussed:
- Renewal baseline: ~10M tokens/month currently (Q3 baseline).
- Expansion ask: add 3 new routes (customer_chat, doc_summarization, search_rerank) for pilot, estimated incremental 20-35M tokens/month depending on success metrics.
- Target unit economics: you mentioned wanting blended pricing ~ $0.90-$1.20 / 1M tokens as a target to hit budget goals (I heard range $10k-$40k/month).

Action items / next steps:
1) Can you confirm expected steady-state monthly tokens for the combined footprint (baseline + expansion) and the target annual budget range? If you can share a ballpark number today I'll use it for a formal proposal.
2) We'll produce a blended-step pricing proposal that shows step-ups at 25M and 75M increments and blended rates for multi-model usage.
3) Rishi will validate unit economics and attach preliminary pricing tables.

I attached a working draft called ACME_Pricing_Draft_v3.pdf with initial blended tables and a separate pricing_tables.xlsx for the calc. Expect a formal proposal (PDF + DocuSign) by Friday if we have your confirmed ranges.

If helpful, can we schedule a 30-min procurement sync Friday morning to walk through the term sheet and SSO/KMS questions?

Thanks
 talk soon.


Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0130

Attachment: ACME_Pricing_Draft_v3.pdf (summary + blended-rate table)
Attachment: pricing_tables.xlsx (workbook with unit-econ calc)

From: Joe Miller <joe.miller@acme-edge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + Expansion: pricing follow-up & next steps

Marissa
 thanks for the recap and for sending the draft. A few clarifications from our side:

- Steady-state expectation: if pilot goes well, we'd expect baseline + production to land at ~45M tokens/month within 2 quarters (10M baseline + ~35M from the three new routes).
- Budget range: our procurement lead gave a target of $30k-$60k/month for the expanded footprint (including infrastructure and support). That aligns with the $0.90-$1.20 / 1M tokens you noted.
- Model mix: we'll likely route user-facing chat to a higher-quality model (open-llama-70B variant) and offload embeddings/rerank to lighter quantized variants. We'll need blended pricing that accounts for model mix
 high/med/low.

Can you show an example blended table that assumes 40% high-quality, 40% mid, 20% low across the 45M tokens? Also confirm whether step-ups apply to total token volume or per-route.

We can do a Friday 10:00am PT procurement sync
 I'll invite procurement@acme-edge.com.


Joe Miller
Head of Product, Acme Edge
joe.miller@acme-edge.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: Joe Miller <joe.miller@acme-edge.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.inference>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + Expansion: pricing follow-up & next steps

Joe
 perfect, thanks for the clarity. Quick answers and what I'll include in the formal proposal:

- Step-up logic: step-ups apply to total billed token volume across routes (not per-route). We'll show a blended example but can also provide per-route breakout if procurement requests it.
- Blended example: I'll seed the proposal using your 40/40/20 mix and the budget range you provided. Initial ballpark blended rates (illustrative only):
  \u2022 High-quality route: $1.80 / 1M tokens
  \u2022 Mid-quality route: $1.00 / 1M tokens
  \u2022 Low-quality route: $0.45 / 1M tokens

With a 40/40/20 mix over 45M tokens/month that translates to a blended headline of ~$1.06 / 1M tokens (~$47.7k/month). I'll include a stepped table with pricing bands at 25M, 50M, 100M so you can see how the blended rate drops with volume.

Rishi
 tagging you to confirm the attached calc and make any tweaks before I finalize the PDF.

I'll send the formal PDF & DocuSign link by Friday AM so you have time for the procurement review.


Marissa

Adding the unit-econ detail I promised
 see summary below and attached pricing_tables.xlsx (tab: stepped_model).

Assumptions used:
- Token unit costs (infrastructure) modeled: high-quality route $0.60 / 1M, mid $0.22 / 1M, low $0.08 / 1M (these include GPU time, nvlink, infra overhead at current utilization).
- Margin target: 25% at baseline for commercial rate.

Stepped price suggestion (per 1M tokens):
- 0-25M: high $1.85, mid $1.05, low $0.50
- 25-75M: high $1.40, mid $0.80, low $0.38
- 75M+: high $1.05, mid $0.60, low $0.28

With 40/40/20 mix at 45M tokens the blended rate using this table = $1.08 / 1M (~$48.6k/month). If Acme wants to target $0.90 / 1M blended we'd need guaranteed commitments at 100M+ or a blended annual prepay structure
 happy to model both.

Attachment: pricing_tables.xlsx (tab: stepped_model)


Rishi Malhotra
